legal_identity.article_2_result: The statute names Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies as the three companies and places their head offices in Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka respectively.
legal_identity.conclusion: SBIC East/Central/West are regional English labels for three distinct Japanese statutory companies. They are not alternative names for SBI Holdings.

claims.claim: Japanese SBIC refers to three distinct companies: Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka.
SBI Holdings, Inc. is a separate company established in 1999.
Tokyo SBIC offered investee-company training that explicitly included ChatGPT.
Nagoya SBIC hosted an investee-only practical generative-AI roundtable; the page does not name ChatGPT.
The reviewed sources establish an OpenAI commercial partnership or a direct XRP relationship with SBIC.
